test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What approximate value should come in the place of the question mark '?' in the following equation?

305.03 ÷ 61.09 × 11.47 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

305.03 ÷ 61.09 × 11.47

**Calculation:**

305.03 ÷ 61.09 × 11.47

⇒ 305 ÷ 61 × 11

⇒ 5 × 11

⇒ 55

From the option closest to 55 is 57

**∴ The required answer is 57.**
